text:
Mercedes-Benz Stadium malitere iwu ya na Mee 19, 2014, ma mepee ya na Ọgọst 26, 2017, n’ogbe etiti Atlanta, na-anọchi Georgia Dome. E wuru ya ihe dị ka US$1.6 ijeri (atụmatụ 2016), e chepụtara ya ka ụlọ ọgbara ọhụrụ maka bọọlụ ọkachamara nke obodo. Ndị Georgia World Congress Center Authority nwere ya, ndị AMB Sports and Entertainment Group na-arụkwa ya n’okpuru onye nwe ya Arthur Blank.

Ndị 360 Architecture (ngalaba HOK) duziri atụmatụ ya, ha na tvsdesign, Goode Van Slyke Architecture, na Stanley Beaman & Sears. Ihe pụrụ iche ya bụ ụlọ elu nwere ike imechi nke nwere “pinwheel” asatọ dị triangular nwere ike imeghe ma mechie n’elu bowl. Ala egwuregwu ya na-adịgide adịgide bụ FieldTurf CORE artificial turf.

Kemgbe 2017, Mercedes-Benz Stadium bụ ụlọ nke NFL’s Atlanta Falcons na MLS’s Atlanta United FC, ebe otu Atlanta NWSL ga-amalite ịgba egwuregwu na 2028. E mere ya site na mbụ ka ọ nabata nnukwu ihe omume n’egwuregwu America. Ọ nabatara Super Bowl LIII na Febụwarị 3, 2019, ebe ndị Patriots meriri ndị Rams 13-3, ma nabatakwa 2018 na 2025 College Football Playoff National Championships. A ga-eji ya nabata Super Bowl LXII na 2028.

Ọ nwere ezigbo akụkọ bọọlụ, ebe ọ nabatara 2018 MLS Cup na egwuregwu abụọ nke 2024 Copa America. Maka 2026 World Cup, a ga-akpọ ya Atlanta Stadium ma nabata egwuregwu asatọ: ise n’oge otu, otu Round of 32, otu Round of 16, na ọkara ikpeazụ na Julaị 15, 2026 — ọrụ kachasị ukwu ya n’asọmpi a.
